hints.text: vornik-companion: you just committed. Before you push, send the diff for review: {delegate} workflow companion-architectural-review, with the diff attached. Fix what is real and send it again until the verdict is GREEN.
vornik-companion: you changed a design document. Once it is committed, ingest it under its repository path ({rag_ingest}), so project memory serves this version and stops serving the old one.
vornik-companion: a test run failed. Before you debug from scratch, recall the symptom ({recall} with the failing test's name or its error), in case it has been seen and solved before.
vornik-companion: you changed a design document. Have it reviewed before you build on it: {upload} it to companion-architectural-review, fix what is real, and repeat until the verdict is GREEN.
vornik-companion: before you start, {recall} the project's engineering rules and prior work on this task. Then delegate what can run while you work, such as research or an edge-case brainstorm.
vornik-companion: several edits since the last commit. {recall} the design of the part you are changing. If the change contradicts it, amend the design in the same change.
